description: This file is an HTML document that serves as the frontend interface for a database visualizer, allowing users to browse databases, tables, and view table data with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar with database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data and resetting UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables, and loads tables if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific table in a database and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data, including headers and cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual data cells, handling nulls, objects, and long text content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncated preview.
